summary: Post-integration review found and repaired two additional failure paths before final acceptance: a monitor could cache an explicit failed assurance result, and source-inventory defects needed an upstream repair action rather than only candidate-code repair.
findings: Failed assurance callbacks now consume retries and remain failed.
Source interpretation repair reruns independent source-only inventories and downstream fidelity; old inventories are retained.
Rejected exception premises now require evidence, preventing unsupported dismissal of an exception.
An unchanged generated reading is no longer recorded as repair progress.
